questions.question: What is single inheritance?
questions.answer: Single inheritance occurs when a child class inherits from one parent class.

questions.question: What is MVC architecture?
questions.answer: Model-View-Controller is a design pattern that separates application logic, user interface, and user input handling.

questions.question: What is an abstract method?
questions.answer: An abstract method is a method declared without an implementation and must be implemented by subclasses.

questions.question: What is PEP 8?
questions.answer: PEP 8 is the official Python style guide that defines coding conventions for readability and consistency.

questions.question: What is a complete binary tree?
questions.answer: A complete binary tree is a binary tree where all levels are completely filled except possibly the last level, which is filled from left to right.

questions.question: What is thrashing?
questions.answer: Thrashing occurs when the system spends more time handling page faults than executing actual processes.

questions.question: What is Partition Tolerance in CAP?
questions.answer: Partition Tolerance means the system continues operating despite communication failures between nodes.

questions.question: What is data independence?
questions.answer: Data independence is the ability to modify the database schema without affecting application programs.

questions.question: What is normalization?
questions.answer: Normalization is the process of organizing database tables to reduce redundancy and improve data integrity.
